title.value: Neural Column Generation for Capacitated Vehicle Routing
title.justification: The title 'Neural Column Generation for Capacitated Vehicle Routing' is mentioned directly at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: Neural Column Generation for Capacitated Vehicle Routing

extractions.description: This paper presents a neural column generation architecture aimed at improving the convergence of column generation processes, which are used to solve complex linear programs like the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP). The architecture leverages deep learning models to predict optimal columns iteratively by treating the problem as a sequential decision-making process. The efficacy of the proposed method is demonstrated on VRP instances, showing its superiority over traditional stabilization techniques.
